key_points: NBCUniversal teamed with Alphabet to stream Peacock on YouTube Premium, driving potential subscriber and ad revenue growth.
CFO indicated no improvement in broadband user losses, highlighting ongoing core business pressure.
Most other headlines are generic analysis or option chain data, providing little new fundamental insight.
Stock showed a >3% intraday gain on the partnership news, indicating market reacted positively.
Dividend defensive narrative appears in some commentary, but no change to dividend policy.
